quarterly_data.signal: Robotics components: LG Innotek's robotics component business generated revenue for the first time this year; the company is mass-producing camera modules for humanoid robot clients at its Paju factory in Korea and expects revenue to increase significantly once full-scale mass production commences. In July it signed a strategic partnership with Japan's TDK for joint development of physical AI sensing solutions, including vision sensing modules and tactile sensing modules for robotic hands (after a robotic-component development agreement with Boston Dynamics in May last year).
